Overprice and bad service.
Mar 2026 • Family
this is supposed to be a premium cafe in HCMC. However, it's nowhere close to being a fine cafe place. We were sitting outside for breakfast. And for almost 10 mins, no waiter or waitress bothered to stop by and ask what we'd like. just a menu drop off until we waived for question on menu. Eventually, we moved to inside as we were bitten by mosquitos. Cost was 100 USD for 5 people (food+ 5 drinks). It's way overprice for that kind of service in Saigon. Food is fusion and average.. We got a much better service and food at other restaurant with that price.. Won't come back to this place whenever I visit Saigon.
